decisions.statement: A credit spent is two rows on one cash account.
The two rows go out of the category that paid and into Audible.
The books are read from a tab-separated list Alan keeps rather than from Audible.
The list's first line names its columns and is not a book.
A line missing any of its five columns is refused by its line number.
An amount that is not a positive number is refused.
A category is named in words and resolved to Monarch's own id before anything is written.
A category no file is titled for is refused rather than passed over.
Nothing is written unless writing was asked for.
The rows are printed either way.
A narrowing that matches no book is refused rather than run over nothing.
The cash account and the list's path are spelled here rather than asked of a page.

definition: the books Alan spent an Audible credit on, written into Monarch as the budget each moved
